answers.en: I can help you with Tech Monster website-related questions. If I cannot confidently answer your question, I will connect you with the support team.
answers.or: Mu Tech Monster website sambandhita question re help kariparibi. Jadi tumara question ra reliable answer mate na miliba, support team tumaku help karibe.
answers.hi: Main Tech Monster website se jude questions mein help kar sakta hoon. Agar mujhe aapke question ka reliable answer nahi mila, to support team aapki help karegi.
answers.mixed: Mu Tech Monster website sambandhita questions re help kariparibi. Jadi answer confirm na hei pare, support team tumaku help karibe.

answers.en: You can contact the support team through the Help & Support section of your Tech Monster dashboard.
answers.or: Tume Tech Monster dashboard ra Help & Support section madhyama re support team ku contact karipariba.
